description: Test harness and utility functions for testing the CronService in a TypeScript project, including mock loggers, store setup, timer control, and test environment setup.

methods.name: createNoopLogger
methods.description: Creates a logger with mock functions for debug, info, warn, and error.

methods.name: createCronStoreHarness
methods.description: Sets up a temporary directory for storing cron jobs, with cleanup.

methods.name: writeCronStoreSnapshot
methods.description: Writes a snapshot of cron jobs to a specified file path.

methods.name: installCronTestHooks
methods.description: Sets up beforeEach and afterEach hooks for timer control and logging in tests.

methods.name: setupCronServiceSuite
methods.description: Prepares a test suite environment with logger and store path setup.

methods.name: createFinishedBarrier
methods.description: Creates a barrier to wait for 'finished' events with 'ok' status for cron jobs.

methods.name: createStartedCronServiceWithFinishedBarrier
methods.description: Creates a CronService instance with a barrier to detect when jobs finish successfully.

methods.name: withCronServiceForTest
methods.description: Runs a test with a temporary CronService instance, ensuring cleanup afterward.

methods.name: createRunningCronServiceState
methods.description: Creates a mock CronService state with specified jobs and current time.

methods.name: disposeCronServiceState
methods.description: Clears the timer in a CronService state if it exists.

methods.name: withCronServiceStateForTest
methods.description: Runs a function with a CronService state, ensuring timer cleanup afterward.

methods.name: createDeferred
methods.description: Creates a deferred promise with external resolve and reject functions.

methods.name: createMockCronStateForJobs
methods.description: Creates a mock CronServiceState with specified jobs and optional current time.
